text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the chat-completions payload shape for the Q3 inferencing launch. My high-level proposal: keep messages[] with roles (system/user/assistant) as the default minimal contract, add an opt-in 'structured_output' block, and a first-pass tool-calling hook (function_call object). @sam @jess thoughts?

sam: +1 to messages[]. Two practical asks: 1) keep a tiny primary path for mobile (role + content_text) to save bytes, 2) make structured output opt-in to avoid perf overhead.

jess: Strongly prefer explicit fields over polymorphic unions. If we let content be string OR object we'll get a lot of SDK/validator pain. Suggest: messages[].content_text (string) and messages[].structured_output (object, opt-in).

owen: From the model/serving side: structured objects are fine but we need schema versioning and a lightweight schema_hint field so model output can be validated. Also recommend a max size on structured_output to protect the KV cache.

leah: Customer voice: several enterprise POCs want tool calling + stable role semantics. Mobile customers asked for minimal payloads to reduce token & bandwidth costs. Prioritization (for GA): 1) minimal messages path, 2) basic function_call hooks, 3) opt-in structured_output, 4) typed/anchored fields.

sam: Implementation timeline: GA should support minimal messages + function_call v1. Structured output behind a query flag (e.g., &structured=true) and SDK helpers. Tool calling shape example: function_call: { name, arguments (stringified JSON) } for v1.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy to staging scheduled Thu 09:30 UTC with flag structured_output=off.

maria: Ok. Launch criteria we need to track in the plan: docs + SDK snippets, migration guide for prompt->messages, perf: median generation latency < 70ms for 2k token window in hosted tier, and clear error/fallback behavior when function_call fails. Also a customer migration playbook for Dedicated/Private installs. Anyone blocking?

owen: :thumbsup: Not blocking. Will provide schema_hint implementation notes and a small eval harness for structured outputs.

jess: I'll draft the RFC and the SDK samples today. Quick snippet to include in docs (examples only):

```json
{
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content_text": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content_text": "Book a meeting tomorrow at 10am", "structured_output": {"intent": "schedule_meeting"}}
  ],
  "function_call": {"name": "calendar.create", "arguments": "{\"time\":\"2026-03-22T10:00:00Z\"}"}
}
```

jess: I'll put the RFC link in #product once it's drafted and tag infra for perf tests.

leah: I'll consolidate customer asks and share acceptance criteria with sales by EOD Friday.

maria: Great — thanks all. We'll default to the minimal messages path for GA, ship function_call v1, and keep structured_output behind opt-in. Follow-up RFC expected by EOD. :rocket:
